notes.note: Heading of the group of live metrics tiles with the host the node runs on: CPU, memory and disk.
Title of the tile with the share of the host's CPU time that was busy.
Hint under the host CPU tile: what the percentage is.

segment.source: Busy share since the last reading, taken every five seconds
segment.target: Upptagen andel sedan förra avläsningen, som görs var femte sekund

notes.note: Hint under the host CPU tile while it has no figure: before the second reading, or on a host where the CPU is not read.

segment.source: Not read yet, or not read on this host
segment.target: Inte avläst än, eller inte avläst på den här värden

notes.note: Title of the tile with the share of the host's memory that is in use.
Hint under the host memory tile: the memory in use and the total, in GiB.
Hint under the host memory tile on a host where the memory is not read.

segment.target: Inte avläst på den här värden

notes.note: Title of the tile with the free space on the file system of the data directory.
Unit after a size in gibibytes.
Hint under the free disk space tile: the size of the file system in GiB.

segment.source: Available of {total} GiB on the data directory's file system
segment.target: Tillgängligt av {total} GiB på datakatalogens filsystem

notes.note: Hint under the free disk space tile when the file system could not be read.

segment.source: The data directory's file system could not be read

notes.note: Warning line of the free disk space tile while the status warns that the data directory's file system is running out of room.

segment.source: Low on space: free some room
